projects.name: AWS VPC provisioning with Terraform & Jenkins
projects.description: A public infrastructure example that defines an AWS network in version-controlled code and puts the Terraform workflow into a Jenkins pipeline.
projects.problem: Make VPC configuration and provisioning steps explicit and repeatable instead of relying on manual console actions.
projects.solution: Terraform defines an AWS VPC with configurable CIDR, DNS support, and DNS hostnames. Jenkins runs init, validate, plan, and apply on a Windows agent using stored AWS credentials.
projects.outcome: A reviewable VPC definition and four-stage provisioning pipeline, with region and network range exposed as configuration variables.
projects.scope: Public infrastructure example. Production usage, deployment success, and performance metrics are not documented in the repository.
